summary: A centrifugal pump without a dynamic shaft seal. The motor turns an outer ring of permanent magnets; their field passes through a thin, stationary containment shell and drags an inner magnet ring that is fixed to the impeller. The pumped liquid is fully enclosed by the casing and shell, and it also lubricates the internal sleeve bearings — so the pump suits toxic, flammable or costly liquids where leakage is unacceptable.

model_configuration.containment_shell: Metallic (Hastelloy/stainless typical); non-metallic shells avoid eddy-current losses

volute_casing.function: Collects flow leaving the impeller and converts velocity into pressure in a spiral passage of increasing area, then discharges through a diffuser nozzle.
volute_casing.construction: Single-volute casing with cutwater (tongue), suction and discharge nozzles and feet; double-volute designs balance radial load on larger pumps.
volute_casing.material: Cast iron, ductile iron, carbon steel, stainless steel (CF8M), duplex.
volute_casing.operating_conditions: Radial load is minimum near BEP and rises at low or high flow.
failure_modes: Cracking from water hammer or nozzle loads
inspection: Nozzle load and pipe support check

impeller_closed.function: Adds energy to the liquid; blades between hub and shrouds accelerate the liquid outward.
impeller_closed.construction: Enclosed impeller (front and back shrouds) keyed and locked on the shaft; balance holes and back wear ring reduce axial thrust.
impeller_closed.material: Cast iron, bronze, stainless steel (CF8M, CA6NM), duplex.
impeller_closed.operating_conditions: Head varies with tip speed squared; operation far from BEP increases recirculation, vibration and NPSH required.

casing_cover.function: Closes the back of the casing and forms the seal chamber.
casing_cover.construction: Machined back plate/stuffing-box cover bolted between casing and bearing frame; may have back wear ring or pump-out vanes.
casing_cover.operating_conditions: Seal chamber pressure depends on balance holes and back clearance.

containment_shell.function: Pressure-retaining barrier between the pumped liquid and the atmosphere; the magnetic field passes through it.
containment_shell.construction: Thin deep-drawn or machined cup bolted to the rear casing.
containment_shell.material: Hastelloy C, titanium or stainless (metallic, with eddy-current heating) or PEEK/ceramic/composite (non-metallic, no eddy losses).
containment_shell.operating_conditions: Metallic shells heat the liquid in the gap; internal circulation must remove this heat. Liquid near its boiling point can flash in the shell.
failure_modes: Rupture from inner magnet rub after bearing failure
Overheating at low flow or dry running
inspection: Shell surface for rub marks at overhaul

stationary_shaft.function: Fixed journal on which the impeller/inner magnet assembly rotates.
stationary_shaft.construction: Ceramic or hard-coated shaft held in the shell and casing.
stationary_shaft.material: Silicon carbide, alumina or hard-coated alloy.
stationary_shaft.operating_conditions: Brittle — avoid thermal and mechanical shock.
failure_modes: Fracture from dry running or shock

product_bearings.function: Radial (and with thrust faces, axial) support of the rotating inner assembly, lubricated by the pumped liquid.
product_bearings.construction: SiC or carbon sleeve bushings with thrust washers.
product_bearings.operating_conditions: Cannot run dry; solids in the liquid accelerate wear; minimum flow must be maintained.
inspection: Power and temperature monitoring for dry-run protection

inner_magnet.function: Driven half of the magnetic coupling; turns the impeller.
inner_magnet.construction: Rare-earth (NdFeB or SmCo) magnets encapsulated in a sealed stainless or polymer-lined carrier fixed to the impeller.
inner_magnet.material: NdFeB/SmCo magnets, stainless or ETFE/PFA encapsulation.
inner_magnet.operating_conditions: Magnet temperature limits (SmCo higher) must not be exceeded or the coupling permanently weakens.
failure_modes: Decoupling (slip) at start-up overload — magnets heat quickly

outer_magnet.function: Driving half of the magnetic coupling, mounted on the motor-driven shaft.
outer_magnet.construction: Magnet ring in a steel carrier surrounding the containment shell with a radial air gap.
outer_magnet.operating_conditions: Runs in air; contact with the shell indicates drive bearing failure.
failure_modes: Rubbing the shell after drive-bearing wear

bearing_bracket.function: Supports the drive shaft bearings and encloses the outer magnet ring.
bearing_bracket.construction: Cast bracket bolted to the rear casing, with foot and bearing bores.
bearing_bracket.operating_conditions: Air side; may include secondary containment on API 685 pumps.
failure_modes: Bearing wear allowing outer magnet contact

radial_bearing.function: Carries radial load near the impeller end.
failure_modes: Overload from operation far from BEP

coupling_flex.function: Transmits torque between motor and pump while accommodating small misalignment and allowing separation for maintenance.
coupling_flex.construction: Two hubs with a flexible element (elastomer spider, pin-and-bush, disc pack or gear); spacer versions allow seal removal without moving the motor.
coupling_flex.material: Steel or cast iron hubs; elastomer or stainless-steel disc elements.
coupling_flex.operating_conditions: Misalignment must still be corrected to manufacturer and pump tolerance; flexible couplings are not a substitute for alignment.
failure_modes: Element wear or rupture from misalignment
inspection: Laser or dial alignment after grouting, after piping connection and at operating temperature

coupling_guard.construction: Sheet-metal or mesh guard fixed to the baseplate; must be in place before start-up.
coupling_guard.material: Steel, aluminium or non-sparking brass for hazardous areas.

motor_frame_h.function: Encloses the stator and supports the bearings; feet or flange mount the motor to the baseplate or pump.
motor_frame_h.construction: Totally enclosed fan-cooled (TEFC) frame with external cooling fins, drive-end and non-drive-end end shields, terminal box and lifting eye.
motor_frame_h.material: Cast iron or aluminium frame; steel fasteners.
motor_frame_h.operating_conditions: Frame size, enclosure (IP rating), efficiency class (e.g. IEC 60034-30-1 IE3/IE4) and insulation class per motor data sheet.
failure_modes: Overheating from blocked fins or fan cover
Soft foot causing frame distortion and vibration
inspection: Check foot shims for soft foot

stator.construction: Laminated electrical-steel core with insulated copper windings; end turns project at each end.
stator.material: Silicon electrical steel, copper magnet wire, Class F/H insulation (typical).
stator.operating_conditions: Rated voltage and frequency; temperature rise within insulation class.

rotor.function: Converts the rotating field into shaft torque (squirrel-cage induction rotor).
rotor.construction: Laminated core with aluminium or copper bars and end rings, shrunk on the shaft and dynamically balanced.
rotor.material: Electrical steel, die-cast aluminium or copper.

motor_bearings.function: Support the motor rotor at drive and non-drive ends.
motor_bearings.construction: Deep-groove ball bearings (roller bearing at drive end on larger belt-driven motors); one end locates axially.
motor_bearings.operating_conditions: Regrease interval depends on speed, size and temperature; insulated bearings recommended with VFDs to prevent electrical fluting.

motor_fan.function: Draws cooling air over the finned frame.
motor_fan.construction: Shaft-mounted radial or bidirectional fan at the non-drive end.
inspection: Visual check through fan cover; clean inlet

fan_cover.function: Guards the fan and directs air along the fins.
fan_cover.construction: Pressed-steel cowl with perforated air inlet.
fan_cover.operating_conditions: Air inlet must be kept clear (minimum clearance to walls per manufacturer).

baseplate.function: Provides a rigid common mounting for pump and driver, maintains alignment and transfers loads to the foundation.
baseplate.construction: Fabricated steel channel frame with machined mounting pads, grout and vent holes, drip rim/drain, and anchor bolt holes.
baseplate.material: Carbon steel, painted; stainless steel for hygienic or corrosive areas.
baseplate.operating_conditions: Must be levelled and fully grouted (epoxy or cementitious) to achieve stiffness; ANSI/HI and API 686 give installation practice.
failure_modes: Voids under the baseplate causing vibration
inspection: Check levelness and anchor bolt tightness
